scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && node scripts/copy-public.js
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.deploy:build: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:build && npx pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env || npx pm2 restart chatty
